title: A counit section gives right extra degeneracies of a comonad resolution
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be an ordinary category and $(T,e,c)$ a comonad on $\mathcal C$. Let $B_\bullet\to\operatorname{const}(\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal C})$ be a supplied standard augmented simplicial resolution of this comonad [def-trf-comonad-standard-resolution]. Let $b\in\mathcal C$ and $v:b\to Tb$ satisfy $e_bv=1_b$. Put $W_n=T^{n+1}b$ for $n\geq0$, $W_{-1}=b$, and write $p:W_\bullet\to\operatorname{const}(b)$ for evaluation of the augmentation. Define
$$t_{-1}=v,\qquad t_n=T^{n+1}(v):W_n\to W_{n+1}\quad(n\geq0).$$
Then the right extra-degeneracy identities hold:
$$p_0t_{-1}=1_b,\qquad d_{n+1}t_n=1_{W_n}\quad(n\geq0),\qquad d_0t_0=t_{-1}p_0,$$
$$d_it_{n+1}=t_nd_i\quad(n\geq0,\ 0\leq i\leq n+1),\qquad s_it_n=t_{n+1}s_i\quad(n\geq0,\ 0\leq i\leq n).$$
Faces and degeneracies are those of $W$ and compositions are in functional order. The data are natural in pairs $(b,v)$: if $f:b\to b'$ satisfies $T(f)v=v'f$, then $T^{n+2}(f)t_n=t'_nT^{n+1}(f)$ for $n\geq0$, and $T(f)t_{-1}=t'_{-1}f$. No equation $c_bv=T(v)v$ is assumed.

source.place: Tag 08ND, lemma-standard-simplicial-homotopy, in Situation 08N9 (situation-adjoint-functors); auxiliary extra-degeneracy argument for the standard object of Tag 08NC (lemma-standard-simplicial). Returned proof step 5: right extra degeneracies from a split counit; the free-object case uses v=F eta_s and the left triangle identity.

proof.text: Write $d_i^m:W_m\to W_{m-1}$ and $s_i^m:W_m\to W_{m+1}$. By [def-trf-comonad-standard-resolution], $p_0=e_b$, $d_i^m=T^i(e_{T^{m-i}b})$ and $s_i^m=T^i(c_{T^{m-i}b})$. Powers applied to arrows preserve composition and identities. Thus $p_0t_{-1}=e_bv=1_b$ and, for $n\geq0$, $d_{n+1}^{n+1}t_n=T^{n+1}(e_b)T^{n+1}(v)=T^{n+1}(e_bv)=1_{W_n}$. Regrouping iterates uses $T^rT^s=T^{r+s}$, obtained by expanding the recursive powers (induction on $r$).

proof.text: For the remaining augmentation boundary, naturality of $e:T\to\mathrm{id}$ at $v:b\to Tb$ says $e_{Tb}T(v)=ve_b$. Substituting $d_0^1=e_{Tb}$, $t_0=T(v)$, $t_{-1}=v$ and $p_0=e_b$ gives $d_0^1t_0=t_{-1}p_0$.

proof.text: Fix $n\geq0$ and $0\leq i\leq n+1$, and put $a=T^{n+1-i}(v)$. Naturality of $e$ at $a:T^{n+1-i}b\to T^{n+2-i}b$ is $e_{T^{n+2-i}b}T(a)=a e_{T^{n+1-i}b}$. Apply $T^i$ and preserve compositions. Its left side becomes $d_i^{n+2}t_{n+1}$ and its right side becomes $t_nd_i^{n+1}$, proving the required face identity including $i=0$ and $i=n+1$.

source.place: Tags 0G5M (example-godement), 08NC (lemma-standard-simplicial), and 08ND (lemma-standard-simplicial-homotopy); explicit right-insertion calculation generalizing the free-object case.

proof.text: Fix $n\geq0$ and $0\leq i\leq n$, and put $a=T^{n-i}(v)$. Naturality of $c:T\to T^2$ at $a$ is $c_{T^{n+1-i}b}T(a)=T^2(a)c_{T^{n-i}b}$. Apply $T^i$ and preserve compositions. Its left side is $s_i^{n+1}t_n$, and its right side is $t_{n+1}s_i^n$. This proves the degeneracy identity, also when $n=i=0$. Only naturality of $c$, not an equation involving $c_bv$, was used.

source.place: Tags 0G5M (example-godement), 08NC (lemma-standard-simplicial), and 08ND (lemma-standard-simplicial-homotopy); explicit right-insertion calculation generalizing the free-object case.

proof.text: Let $f:b\to b\prime$ satisfy $T(f)v=v\prime f$. Applying the functor $T^{n+1}$ to this equality gives $T^{n+2}(f)T^{n+1}(v)=T^{n+1}(v\prime)T^{n+1}(f)$, which is exactly $T^{n+2}(f)t_n=t_n\prime T^{n+1}(f)$ for every $n\geq0$. In degree $-1$ the desired equality is the assumed equation itself. These formulas prove naturality for all the specified data.
